justifications.evidence: gate.log records 56 passed EXIT=0 at rev 1824768c3 asserting every done-when item, but the fragment at line 15 and the manifest artifacts line 15 cite the gate figure at the base 425dd5620, and the manifest omits its baseline_suite/after_suite fields, so the record's revision citation is muddled.
justifications.fit: the added symbols DocumentsOptions and run_documents_stage are named by what they do with no plan label, and documents.py follows the sibling discover folds' stage-plus-thin-wrapper idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: documents.py:17 freezes DocumentsOptions on the settled spellings and documents.py:41 exposes run_documents_stage, so the extraction the goal states is present with the command left a thin wrapper.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses DiscoveryConfig, run_discovery, DocumentDiscoveryState and run_document_discovery unchanged and forks no capability; a search over imas_codex/cli/discover found no other owner of a documents stage.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 425dd5620..1824768c3 touches only imas_codex/cli/discover/documents.py, tests/cli/test_discover_documents_stage.py and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
